title: Battle of Portada de Guías
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Portada de Guías", at revision 1370586486, opens: "The Battle of Portada de Guías, also known as the Battle of Guía or Battle of Piñonate, took place between the Chilean Army and the secessionist Peruvian Republic in 1838, during the War of the Confederation." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q5722806, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle between the Peruvian Republic and the United Restoration Army in 1838". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
